name: sightpress/module-template
description: A starting point for a SightPress module: SightPress is a powerful CMS for everyone, designed with blind and low-vision creators and audiences in mind. Create your own module from it with composer create-project, then make it yours.

acme.my_module.name: My module
acme.my_module.description: Say in one or two sentences what your module adds to a site.
acme.my_module.when-off: Say what visitors and admins no longer see while it is off.

scripts-descriptions.cs-check: Check the code style (PSR-12) without changing files.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the unit and integration test suites.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the integration test suite: the module installed in SightPress.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the unit suite with coverage; fail below 100% lines or methods or on any coverage ignore annotation.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run every check that must pass before a commit.
scripts-descriptions.fix: Apply Rector refactorings, then fix the code style.
